FINE ARTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: FINE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the volume
   B. The speed of the music
   C. The ticket price
   D. Only the costume

2. Best practice when working on Drawing .: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Drawing . with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Drawing ..
   C. Refuse all feedback on Drawing ..
   D. Disrupt classmates during Drawing ..

3. Best practice when working on Photography: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Photography.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Photography.
   C. Practise Photography with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Photography.

4. Best practice when working on Graphic Design 2.2 2D Digital Animation 2.3 Photography 2.4 Fabric Decoration-Ba: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Graphic Design 2.2 2D Digital Animation 2.3 Photography 2.4 Fabric Decoration-Ba with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Graphic Design 2.2 2D Digital Animation 2.3 Photography 2.4 Fabric Decoration-Ba.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Graphic Design 2.2 2D Digital Animation 2.3 Photography 2.4 Fabric Decoration-Ba.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Graphic Design 2.2 2D Digital Animation 2.3 Photography 2.4 Fabric Decoration-Ba.

5. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Red, blue, and yellow
   B. Brown, pink, and gold
   C. Black, white, and grey
   D. Green, orange, and purple

6. Best practice when working on Painting: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Painting.
   B. Damage equipment used for Painting.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Painting.
   D. Practise Painting with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. Best practice when working on Fabric Decoration- Appliqué 3.0 Indigenous Crafts 3.1 Pottery and Ceramics 3.2 S: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Fabric Decoration- Appliqué 3.0 Indigenous Crafts 3.1 Pottery and Ceramics 3.2 S.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Fabric Decoration- Appliqué 3.0 Indigenous Crafts 3.1 Pottery and Ceramics 3.2 S.
   C. Practise Fabric Decoration- Appliqué 3.0 Indigenous Crafts 3.1 Pottery and Ceramics 3.2 S with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Fabric Decoration- Appliqué 3.0 Indigenous Crafts 3.1 Pottery and Ceramics 3.2 S.

8. Best practice when working on Mosaic: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Mosaic.
   B. Practise Mosaic with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Mosaic.
   D. Damage equipment used for Mosaic.

9. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   B. Remove the need for rules
   C. Replace drinking water
   D. Guarantee a trophy

10. Best practice when working on Drawing 1.2 Painting 1.3 Mosaic 2.0: Multimedia Arts 2.1 Graphic Design 2.2 2D D: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Drawing 1.2 Painting 1.3 Mosaic 2.0: Multimedia Arts 2.1 Graphic Design 2.2 2D D.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Drawing 1.2 Painting 1.3 Mosaic 2.0: Multimedia Arts 2.1 Graphic Design 2.2 2D D.
   C. Practise Drawing 1.2 Painting 1.3 Mosaic 2.0: Multimedia Arts 2.1 Graphic Design 2.2 2D D with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Drawing 1.2 Painting 1.3 Mosaic 2.0: Multimedia Arts 2.1 Graphic Design 2.2 2D D.

11. Best practice when working on D Digital Animation Classic and motion tween: (1 mark)
   A. Practise D Digital Animation Classic and motion tween with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during D Digital Animation Classic and motion tween.
   C. Refuse all feedback on D Digital Animation Classic and motion tween.
   D. Damage equipment used for D Digital Animation Classic and motion tween.

12. Best practice when working on Fabric Decoration: Batik and Discharge Techniques: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Fabric Decoration: Batik and Discharge Techniques.
   B. Practise Fabric Decoration: Batik and Discharge Techniques with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Fabric Decoration: Batik and Discharge Techniques.
   D. Damage equipment used for Fabric Decoration: Batik and Discharge Techniques.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Graphic Design and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain D Digital Animation 2.3 Photography 2.4 Fabric Decoration-Batik and Discharge 2. and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain D Digital Animation Classic and motion tween and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Photography and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

====

1. B — The speed of the music

2. A — Practise Drawing . with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. C — Practise Photography with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. A — Practise Graphic Design 2.2 2D Digital Animation 2.3 Photography 2.4 Fabric Decoration-Ba with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. C — Practise Fabric Decoration- Appliqué 3.0 Indigenous Crafts 3.1 Pottery and Ceramics 3.2 S with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. B — Practise Mosaic with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. A — Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

10. C — Practise Drawing 1.2 Painting 1.3 Mosaic 2.0: Multimedia Arts 2.1 Graphic Design 2.2 2D D with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Graphic Design; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
